name: zvideo_fx_surface_apply_green_mask_rect
description: zVideo_FxSurface::ApplyGreenMaskRect applies the green-channel mask to a pass-3 FX surface region or queues a translucent green quad on hardware renderer paths.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja still has a limited HLIL rendering for the QueueSolidQuad double argument; disassembly shows the pushed 0.3 double constant.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly at 0x48eb80 copies the optional rect or full FX surface bounds, fetches RGB masks, queues a green solid quad on hardware paths, and masks software pixel pairs with the duplicated green mask.
The native smoke verifies software masking over the selected region without modifying edge pixels.
The native smoke verifies hardware-path queuing with the green mask, target rect, and alpha-derived ARGB color.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x48eb80 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
